name: plan creation (bare tools): consult the IWC registry before drafting
description: Runs under LOOM_GALAXY_TOOLS=bare (and its ORBIT_ spelling, which readEnv prefers if the ambient env sets it), so the Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. Same request as plan-consults-iwc: a workflow-shaped task IWC covers, asserted on the search call rather than on the workflow chosen. Drafting must not jump ahead to importing or invoking anything. Bare-path clone of plan-consults-iwc; the original covers the MCP path until 2e deletes it.
inputs: I have paired-end Illumina reads and want a standard quality-control and contamination-screening run before assembly. Draft a plan; don't execute anything yet.
